name: Surge of Strength
text: Legacy deals 3 melee damage to 1 target. You may play an additional card this turn.

name: Inspiring Presence
text:
At the start of your turn, each hero other than Legacy may deal 1 projectile damage to any target.

At the end of your turn, Legacy deals 1 projectile damage to 1 target.

name: Next Evolution
text: Legacy is immune to damage from environment cards. At the end of your turn, Legacy deals 1 melee damage to 1 target.
